title: 30 s cinematic cue with hits at 8, 16 and 24 s
prompt: Cinematic trailer cue, orchestral hybrid: taiko and orchestral percussion, low strings, brass, sub booms, tension risers. Epic, dark, precise.

sections.name: Tension
sections.desc: quiet ticking pulse, soft low strings, suspense

sections.name: Build
sections.desc: starts with a huge BOOM impact hit at the first beat, then rising strings and brass swell with a riser into the next section

sections.name: Epic
sections.desc: starts with a massive impact hit, full orchestra, driving taiko percussion

sections.name: Final hit
sections.desc: one final massive impact hit at the first beat, then everything stops and the hit rings out
